brief:
◆ Market Overview

Futures point to a modest green open with small caps leading (+0.94% on IWM) as Middle East peace talks spark cautious optimism. VIX uptick to 26.43 despite the rally suggests underlying tension remains, with SPY testing resistance near $746. Memorial Day volume will be light, making moves potentially more volatile.

◆ What to Watch

  • Memorial Day Trading - Thin volume could amplify moves in either direction, watch for institutional positioning ahead of Tuesday's return
  • Chicago Fed National Activity Index - Key economic data drop at 12:30 ET will gauge economic momentum
  • Treasury Auctions - 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 3:30 ET will test demand amid geopolitical uncertainty
  • Energy Sector - Oil dropping on peace hopes, watch XLE for continuation or reversal signals

◆ Sector Rotation

Healthcare leads at +1.19% with Tech close behind at +1.01%, suggesting a flight to defensive growth plays. Comm Services alone in the red (-0.53%) on regulatory overhang. The healthcare strength combined with utilities gaining +0.80% screams risk-off despite the green headlines.
✦ Bull Case
Middle East peace progress removes major geopolitical premium, oil prices falling should boost consumer spending power and ease inflation pressures into summer.
⚡ Key Driver
Iran-US memorandum talks are the wildcard - any concrete progress or breakdown will move oil, dollar, and risk assets significantly through the session.
⚠ Bear Case
VIX rising alongside equities is a classic divergence warning. Light Memorial Day volume could see algorithmic selling cascade if peace talks stall or geopolitical headlines turn negative.

◆ Levels That Matter

  • SPY $746 - Immediate resistance, break above targets $750 psychological level
  • QQQ $720 - Key technical level to reclaim for continued tech leadership
  • VIX 25 - Support level, break below signals genuine risk-on sentiment
  • XLE $95 - Energy sector support as oil falls, watch for bounce or breakdown

Not a prediction. A preparation. Make your plan before the bell.
